result:
I’d make it impossible to fully dehumanize anyone.

Not by forcing love or agreement, but by making another being’s inner reality as self-evident to you as your own. Most of the world’s worst things—war, exploitation, cruelty, indifference—run on the ability to look at someone and quietly file them under “doesn’t really count.” Remove that file, and everything else has to change.
